 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. LaMelo Ball and the Minnesota Timberwolves will host Darius Garland and the Los Angeles Clippers on Friday as the Emirates NBA Cup group-stage matchups commence during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 With star guard Anthony Edwards injured and unavailable, Minnesota fell 119-114 to the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday. Guard Ball played 28 minutes, scoring eight points and dishing out a team-high eight assists. Forward Jonathan Kuminga scored a team-high 20 points while adding three rebounds and five assists. Forward Jaden McDaniels scored 19 points and recorded seven rebounds and four assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Clippers vs Timberwolves TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 Minnesota Timberwolves guard LaMelo Ball (1).Bruce Kluckhohn-Imagn Images
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 Venue: Target Center, Minneapolis
 TV: ClipperVision, NBA League Pass
 Live stream: NBA League Pass through Amazon Prime Video
 Fans can watch the game for free through various avenues. One option is Amazon Prime, where users can sign up for a seven-day free trial of NBA League Pass. Another option is DraftKings Sportsbook, which offers a three-month free trial. Users must make a minimum deposit of $10.
 The Clippers are coming off a 103-87 loss to Austin Reaves and the Los Angeles Lakers on Wednesday. Rookie guard Keaton Wagler scored a team-high 21 points in 28 minutes off the bench. Guard Darius Garland scored 14 points and dished out a team-high five assists, while forward Derrick Jones Jr. contributed 15 points on 6-for-10 shooting from the field and 3-for-5 shooting from 3-point range.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Los Angeles will next head to the Chase Center on Sunday to face Stephen Curry and the Warriors, while Minnesota will face Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs on Saturday.
